card.name: Ending of necrotizing fasciitis and similar words
card.fires_on: The final piece of a long word split into parts, most often "itis" in "necrotizing fasciitis" in warnings about genital or perineal infection. It also fires on a few other word endings such as "owing" in "inflowing" and "at" in "ProAmatine".

modes.label: Fasciitis ending
modes.description: The "itis" that completes "fasciitis" in necrotizing fasciitis warnings.

modes.label: Other split words
modes.description: Endings of other long words split into pieces, in general text or brand names.
modes.example: connected to the Krishna and Godavari systems by over 68 infl<<owing>> drains and channels.
